paper_title: Formulation and manufacturing optimization of lithium-ion graphite-based electrodes via machine learning
paper_authors: Stavros X. Drakopoulos, Azarmidokht Gholamipour-Shirazi, Paul MacDonald, Robert C. Parini, Carl D. Reynolds, David L. Burnett, Ben Pye, Kieran B. O'Regan, Guanmei Wang, Thomas M. Whitehead, Gareth J. Conduit, Alexandru Cazacu, Emma Kendrick

Table_S1.description: 27 formulation / manufacturing protocols of the historical model development campaign (corresponds exactly to Cases 12 to 38 in AS-Cell_Data)

Table_S2.description: Detailed slurry mixing procedures (dry mix, binder addition, planetary mixing speed/time)

Table_S3.description: Experimental performance summary of the historical screening cells (formation, C/5 capacity, retention)

Table_S4.description: Baseline model benchmark comparison on 5-fold cross validation: Lasso, Random Forest, vs Alchemite neural network

Table_S5.description: Independent variables of the design space and specifications for the AI-designed electrode: formulation constrained within observed range (graphite ~95%, C45 ~1%, CMC ~1.5%, SBR ~2.25%, CMC:SBR 2:3 ratio; coating gap 100-200 um, speed 0.2-0.4 m/min, drying temperature 60-100 C, calendered)

Table_S6.description: Comparison between Alchemite model prediction and experimental validation cell(s). The paper reports that AI-designed prospective validation cells achieved at least 2.5x higher D30 than unoptimized cells of equivalent active mass.

Partition_A_HISTORICAL_MODEL_DEVELOPMENT.description: Historical 27 protocols (Cases 12 to 38, AS-1 to AS-143, 85 valid training cells). Used to fit initial machine learning models.
Partition_A_HISTORICAL_MODEL_DEVELOPMENT.target_availability: Contains formation cycles and D1, D2, D5, D10, D20, D50. Does NOT contain D30.
Partition_A_HISTORICAL_MODEL_DEVELOPMENT.role_in_benchmark: Available for pre-training or historical surrogate warm start.

Partition_B_PROSPECTIVE_MODEL_VALIDATION.description: Nextrode campaign with Alchemite (Cases 39 to 74, ASC-1 to ASC-108, 19 slurry samples, 36 cases, 108 cells).
Partition_B_PROSPECTIVE_MODEL_VALIDATION.target_availability: Explicitly contains D30(mAh) for 72 cells (69 with positive discharge capacity), enabling exact calculation of discharge_specific_capacity_cycle30_mah_g.
Partition_B_PROSPECTIVE_MODEL_VALIDATION.role_in_benchmark: Primary candidate pool for sequential closed-loop rediscovery benchmark where D30 target is known retrospectively.

Partition_C_PUBLISHED_ALCHEMITE_DESIGN_V.description: The specific physical cell(s) manufactured from the Alchemite design reported in Table S6.
Partition_C_PUBLISHED_ALCHEMITE_DESIGN_V.source_grounding_result: The Alchemite-designed electrode corresponds to the optimized regime identified in Partition B (Sample 10 / Case 56-58: 95.24% graphite, 1.01% C45, 1.50% CMC, 2.25% SBR, gap 100 um, speed 0.2-0.4 m/min, 60 C drying, calendered), where D30 reaches 384-402 mAh/g. However, because Table S6 in the paper is reported as an aggregated validation comparison rather than a distinct single-row cell ID distinct from the Nextrode series, Mode 2 rediscovery must be reported with precise scientific caveats.
